resources.string: Seek preview thumbnails come from seekr.tv. The built-in key is shared by everyone and allows only 40 different titles a day, so previews can stop working. Get a free key at seekr.tv and paste it here. Leave it empty to use the built-in key.
Scan with your phone to paste your key there.
Paste your key from seekr.tv. The TV checks it and saves it.
Sent. Check the TV to see if the key was accepted.
Could not reach the TV. Is the Seekr key screen still open?
